wp_ward_repair_desc: Uses fuel items from its inventory to repair damaged structures within range.
wp_ward_refuel_desc: Keeps nearby fires, sconces and smelters fueled from its inventory.
wp_ward_spawnproof_desc: Prevents creatures from spawning within its radius.
wp_ward_defender_desc: Insert a trophy. When enemies come near, it summons a friendly copy of that creature to defend your base.
